description.value: Tokyo Joe's Sushi is a Japanese restaurant in Richmond offering an extensive menu spanning sushi rolls, sashimi, nigiri, udon, teriyaki, and donburi. The restaurant supports online ordering with quick pickup, making it a practical food stop for cyclists passing through the Richmond area. A dedicated vegetarian rolls section and party tray options round out a menu broad enough to suit most touring appetites.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: rack at 26m; rack at 54m; rack at 76m; rack at 85m; rack at 87m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at tokyojoessushi.com is live and confirms the OSM address (8211 Ackroyd Rd #130, Richmond, BC) and provides a phone number absent from OSM. The menu page confirms a dedicated Vegetarian Rolls section, and the homepage confirms online ordering with pickup, establishing takeout. No evidence on the website addresses bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling amenities, so those are null.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; +1 604-273-3868 sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, active restaurant suitable as a food stop for touring cyclists, but none of the WWC required criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from available evidence. A site visit or direct contact is needed to verify at least bike parking or visibility before including.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page includes a dedicated 'Vegetarian Rolls' section with multiple items including Kappa Roll, Yam Roll, Avocado Roll, Vegetable Roll, and others

price.label: Cheap eats
price.signal: Most rolls $5–$10; premium rolls ~$20–25. Quick-service model.
